modules.module_title: Collect adequate information from patients/ relatives/ referring physician

pcs.pc_description: collect the basic information about the patient in the prescribed format as per organizational policies and procedures related to their present ailment and symptoms
enter the clinical, medical, family, gynecological, allergic and treatment history of the patient in the prescribed format
gather evidences supporting the clinical history of the patient wherever available and applicable
complete the format by enquiring for information from the patients/ relatives/ referring physician
record the observations obtained from basic general/systematic physical examination as per organizational policies and procedures

exhibit sensitization while delivering services and obtaining information in terms of the patient’s language, ethnicity, race, age, gender, geographical location, socioeconomic, and cultural backgrounds
communicate appropriately while interacting with a person with disability
obtain the consent forms from the patients as per policies and procedures
maintain patient’s confidentiality

modules.module_title: Support in providing diagnostic and pharmacy related services

pcs.pc_description: identify the diagnostic tests which can be performed in the telehealth set-up and the ones which need to be referred
assist in performing basic tele-diagnostic tests through remote patient monitoring programs as per standard operating procedures
match the patient's details with the requisition form to ensure accurate identification
seek patient’s information with reference to the allergies, any previous experience of fainting during previous injections or blood draws, history of bleeding disorder, medications etc.
reassure the person and make them comfortable before beginning the procedure for anxious patients
provide details of procedure to be performed to the patient and obtain verbal consent to proceed
maintain supplies and stocks for avoiding shortage of materials before the end of the procedure
organize all the equipment needed for the procedure and place it within safe and easy reach
ensure all equipment to be used is clean, sterilized and in working condition
prepare the test site of patient using standard procedures for performing tele-diagnostic tests
maintain safety and hygiene while performing tele-diagnostic tests
record observations as well as test results in the prescribed format
discard all used items in the appropriate category of waste receptacles/bins
perform hand hygiene before and after performing tele-diagnostic tests
provide information to the patients regarding local diagnostic facilities for the diagnostic tests which cannot be performed in telehealth set-up
follow-through with the patient/diagnostic center for the referred diagnostic tests
obtain the report and test result from patient/diagnostic center
provide information to the patients regarding local pharmacies for ensuring medicine availability
follow-through with the patient till they get the prescribed medicine
explain prescription dose to the patient

modules.module_title: Update and store patient related information and provide it to the specialty site

pcs.pc_description: update all kinds of information either personal or clinical in the patient records electronically
scan and upload the supporting evidences like films, videos, photos, documents, forms and other medical records, etc. in the patient records
ensure the correct registration ID is used while updating the information
keep patient’s record carefully, properly and confidentially as per policies and procedures
provide the information to the specialty physician periodically
identify if the emergency is medical or non- medical
coordinate with the local emergency service provider as per type of emergency situations
inform to the patient’s family about emergency
respond to the emergency within emergency response system's average response time
perform basic life support or basic first aid in medical emergencies, as and when required
assist in handling or operating remote patient monitoring programs during emergency

modules.module_title: Management of Healthcare Waste (Biomedical and General waste)

pcs.pc_description: segregate healthcare waste as per the updated organizational/ state policies
handle, package, label, store, transport and dispose off waste appropriately as per scope of work
identify infection risks and plan for response appropriately as per organizational policies under scope of work
follow incident reporting protocols as per SOPs in incidents such as needle stick injuries etc.
follow spill management protocols

modules.module_title: Manage database creation, updation and retrieval

pcs.pc_description: gather all sorts of information necessary to create the database of patients, incoming calls, equipment, logistics, spare parts, vendors and inventory, etc. into the prescribed format
cross-check if the database is accurate and properly formatted in the layout
update the database periodically
convert the database into MIS reports, statistical reports, etc. as and when required
check if the inventory data software reflects actual inventory levels of spare parts, logistics and equipment

modules.module_title: Manage accounts and funds at patient site

pcs.pc_description: maintain the records of financial transactions like cash flow, cheques, demand draft, card swapping, direct bank transfer, etc. appropriately and precisely as per organizational policy
generate, receive and store the invoices, bills, vouchers, receipts, etc. appropriately
ensure reconciliation of bank statements with appropriate personnel
check if there is proper and complete authorization in each financial transaction
ensure proper and secure filing of accounts, funds and other related documents physically and electronically

modules.module_title: Manage documentation, purchases, inventory and medical records

pcs.pc_description: plan the replenishment of the equipment, spare parts, logistics as per organizational policy and availability of funds

coordinate with the appropriate and listed vendor for the purchases as per timelines, quality and financials required
review the medical records for completeness and maintain them as per the organization protocol
store current and past medical records safely and securely as per organizational policy
retain all medical records for a time specified in the organizational policies
dispose of medical records as per Standard Operating Procedure (SOPs)
take written consent of authorized officer or follow organizational policy for sharing any patient related information to others
ensure that medical records are treated confidential
ensure the safety of records with respect to protection from insects, termites and exposure to heat, fire, dampness and dust
arrange documents and records properly in shelves in numeric order to facilitate easy retrieval when required

pcs.pc_description: organize on-site training sessions for users of the telemedicine, videoconferencing, and remote monitoring systems periodically
prepare telemedicine facilities and equipment for conducting educational sessions
prepare the training calendar of the sessions and circulate the same to the concerned personnel
coordinate with the appropriate faculty for the sessions
ensure the participation of the concerned personnel in the scheduled program

modules.module_title: Organize promotion and outreach activities for the telehealth services

pcs.pc_description: identify the different groups/organizations to be targeted for telehealth marketing
organize the promotional material (print/audio- visual) for the promotion of telehealth program as per the policies and procedures
facilitate the field visits of concerned personnel for planning the outreach of the telehealth services
organize community outreach activities for the promotion of telehealth services as advised by the authority like health screening camps, awareness activities, promotional campaigns, etc.
perform mock demonstrations of the telehealth system for visitors for better sensitization and word-of-mouth promotion as per organizational policies
promote the schedule of mobile set-ups with dates, timing and location much before the schedule for maximum participation

modules.module_title: Facilitate the telehealth services via home visits, mobile set-ups and case discussions

pcs.pc_description: identify the patients who are unable to visit the telehealth facility like geriatric/ disable/ psychiatric/ paralytic patients, etc.
explain to the patients about benefits and usage of primary home telehealth technologies
follow-through with the patient or their relative if they are facing any difficulty while using the home telehealth technologies.
collect data and evidences from the patients using home telehealth technology by arranging home visits of concerned personnel periodically
assist the patient in transmitting the patient data using home telehealth technology to specialty physician as and when required
document the data of users of home telehealth technology separately as per protocols and procedures
schedule mobile telehealth set-ups by using vans/ambulances/other sources for facilitating the telehealth services in consultation with concerned authority

organize the relevant case folders for all concerned personnel before the case conferences
document all case conferences organized as per organizational policies and procedures
support the personnel during utilization of the telehealth technology and premises for online educational programs, assessments, health surveys for various government/non-government entities, etc.
